CS 1.6 was one of the last games where your nickname meant more than your rank. There were no profiles to flex, no skins to show off, no matchmaking badge beside your name just reputation. If you were good, people remembered you. …
Still the best Counter-Strike. I don't think any game will ever top how movement feels on GoldSrc. Maybe it's nostalgia, maybe it's Maybelline, but either way, you can't beat it. …
